_note: boards.json recorded `drift-filter-note-position-BOARD-CONFLICT`. Both
halves resolved here:
POSITION — the board's frame orders Header · Filter row · Issue · note,
i.e. the 'two issues are hidden' line comes AFTER the rows. The panel
rendered it FIRST, inside the scroller, under a comment that cited this
same board. The board wins on layout (visual → board), and it sits outside
the scroller so a long list cannot push it out of sight — the same call
SavesChrome made for the History retention note.
CONFLICT — the two Issues boards are drawn at different widths. 164:22's
art is 280 (close glyph x252, Fix x224, title w180); 164:2's is 360, and
boards.json's 2026-08-31 walk of 164:2 verified 360 against the running
panel. The panel is a right-hand panel (`--size/panel-right` = 360), so
360 is measured here and 164:30's w-180 — the only property that depends
on the 280 frame — is not anchored.
NOT anchored, and why:
164:22 root — the board fills it bg-card; the panel's own root is
transparent and takes white from the shell slot it mounts into.
164:23/164:24/164:25 Header — PanelHeader size="panel" is already 48h /
14px / ink per this board; the one delta is its 21px line box against the
board's 20. That primitive is shared by every 360 panel and its 21 comes
from the `ui/14 · panel title` type style, so a 1px screen-board delta
does not get to move it.
164:30 issue title — width 180 is the 280-frame measurement (see above).
Its type is measured on `issue-message-0` via the 13/20 it shares with
the row; the width is the only board property that does not survive the
width conflict.
164:29 the dot — the panel leads the row with a severity ICON (lucide
AlertCircle, tinted by tone), which carries information the board's plain
8px ellipse does not. Board 164:2's walk did not flag it either.
